title: Project 33 shared militarized design point (Phase 1)
basis: Single reviewed input file for every model (four-bar, static margin, spring, reliability), resolving discrepancy D-010. Phase 1 values; Phase 2 (warhead) and Phase 4 (motor/structure) revisions will supersede with a new revision field, never silently.

four_bar.comment: Crank pivot A forward (toward nose), fin hinge D aft; +x from A to D. Fin panel rides the output link DC. Fin folds flush FORWARD alongside the body and deploys to a 90 deg hard stop. Linkage toggle (crank-coupler collinearity, |AC| = b + c) sits 1.5 deg BEYOND the stop, so the spring-loaded crank cannot be back-driven by fin loads without overcoming the near-toggle mechanical advantage.

main_fins.comment: Resized per corrected Barrowman derivation (C5 resolution). Rectangular planform; molded CFRP sandwich with unidirectional spar caps; areal mass target 3.4 kg/m^2.
main_fins.material: CFRP quasi-isotropic faces over foam core with UD spar caps

canards.comment: Unchanged planform from the committed OpenRocket model; leading-edge station now follows OpenRocket absolute axial semantics (0.180 m from the nose tip; the pre-Phase-1 scripts misread 0.218 m).

mass_model.comment: Explicit component breakdown replacing the ambiguous OpenRocket tube overrides (which lumped unknown contents). Positions from nose tip.

dry_components.name: warhead_simulator_ballast
dry_components.source: Phase 2 GP loadout mass simulator; inert ballast until Phase 2

dry_components.name: forward_body_assembly
dry_components.source: OpenRocket tube-1 override (tube, canards, canard servos, avionics, battery)

dry_components.name: aft_body_structure
dry_components.source: derived: fiberglass tube 2 (2.54 mm wall), motor mount, centering rings, hinges, linkages, springs

dry_components.name: main_fins
dry_components.source: 4 x 0.120 kg per main_fins spec above

motor.data_source: thrustcurve.org motor page for AeroTech G64W (NAR-certified), retrieved 2026-11-14

spring.comment: Torsion spring on the four-bar crank pivot. Free position 30 deg of crank beyond the fin stop. Rate is a specified design value, not a measured one.
spring.rate_basis: sized by mechanism/spring_sizing.py at this design point; catalog-scale music-wire torsion spring, specified not measured

deployment_trigger.comment: Rocket-side launch detection gating fin release. Supersedes the 15 g one-shot threshold (MIL-DEV-010): the G64W cannot produce 15 g on this mass.

flight_regime.barrowman_validity: subsonic, low aspect-ratio interference included; no compressibility correction applied

warhead_bay.comment: Phase 2: forward bay ahead of the CG, replacing the Phase 1 inert ballast. CONSTANT TOTAL BAY MASS of 250 g across all loadouts (case + liner + fill + structural ballast ring), so every loadout shares the Phase 1 mass properties and static margin 1.66-1.76 cal. Bay occupies the nose cone and the first 60 mm of the forward body; the canard servo ring moves aft of the bay.

GP_HE_FRAG.explosive_type: Composition A5 (TNT equivalent factor 1.15; effective ~127 g TNT-eq)
GP_HE_FRAG.fragment_design: natural fragments from heat-treated case, ~0.15-0.25 g class
GP_HE_FRAG.fuze: contact PD, instantaneous or 0-20 ms selectable

HEAT.liner_material: OFHC copper, 60 deg conical, liner CD 58 mm
HEAT.fuze: contact PD through standoff probe, PI (point initiate) at 2 CD standoff

EFP.description: Explosively-formed penetrator (light armor / vehicle kill at standoff)
EFP.liner_material: armco iron or OFHC copper dish, CD 55 mm
EFP.fuze: RF proximity (2-6 m gate) or contact PD

fuze.comment: Phase 2: dual-event S&A. Safe until launch; armed only by BOTH sustained launch acceleration (the same 2 g / 150 ms event that gates fin deployment) AND canard-deployment confirmation, plus a motor-burn time gate. The S&A logic lives in rocket firmware with a hardware interrupt chain to the fire set.
fuze.type: contact PD baseline, standoff RF proximity option, delay-selectable
arming_events: sustained launch acceleration >= 2 g for 150 ms
flight time >= motor burn time + 0.5 s
fuze.proximity_option: 5.8 GHz CW Doppler RF module, 0.5-2 mW, gated 2-6 m; acoustic backup under consideration
fuze.backup_initiation: ignition servo retained for motor ignition only (MIL-DEV-006); electric initiator is the primary motor path

phase4_structure.comment: Phase 4 military structure (MIL-DEV-007). Composite per the C8 laminate spec; 7075-T6 load-path metallics; PLA+/PETG airframe parts superseded.
phase4_structure.load_path_metallics: 7075-T6: hinge pins (3 mm), motor-mount rings, warhead case
phase4_structure.fin_material: molded CFRP sandwich with UD spar caps (unchanged from Phase 1)

canard_servos.margin: ~1.7x torque margin at the sizing load

motor.class_comment: Military-class solid sized by Simulation/motor_sizing.py for the 1-3 km tactical envelope with 10 percent margin; supersedes the G64W for tactical rounds (MIL-DEV-008). G64W retained for Phase 6 inert flights.
motor.ignition: electric initiator primary; ignition servo backup (MIL-DEV-006)

environmental_budgets.vibration: MIL-STD-810 method 514 style, 20-2000 Hz random; canard servos hold position under burnout dynamic load
